item.title: Noble Cedar by French Avenue – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Carolina Herrera Cedar Chic
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Overview

Noble Cedar by French Avenue sits at the clean end of the woody spectrum. Aldehydes and bergamot give it a soapy, freshly-laundered lift, orange blossom softens the middle, and the base is exactly what the name promises — cedarwood, smoothed out with white musk.

Understated and skin-close rather than loud. The kind of thing that reads as expensive without announcing itself, and works year-round on anyone. Widely mentioned as an affordable route to Carolina Herrera's Cedar Chic.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Aldehydes, Bergamot
Middle: Orange Blossom
Base: White Musk, Cedarwood

item.title: Pacific Aloha by Rayhaan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Room 1015 Wavechild
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Pacific Aloha by Rayhaan is a tropical fruit cocktail with an aquatic floor underneath it. Blood orange, melon and lemon lead, candied watermelon and coconut deliver the suntan-lotion sweetness the name promises, and marine notes, cacao and amberwood keep the whole thing from collapsing into pure candy.

Sweet, juicy and salt-air fresh at the same time — a beach fragrance with enough weight to carry into a night out. Often mentioned in the same breath as Room 1015 Wavechild.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blood Orange, Melon, Lemon
Middle: Candied Watermelon, Coconut
Base: Marine Notes, Cacao, Amberwood

item.title: Green Bet by Paris Corner – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Green Bet by Paris Corner opens loud and bright — bergamot and lime over a spiced edge — then settles into something considerably more serious. Neroli, aromatic herbs and a whisper of violet and rose bridge the gap, and the base does the real work: guaiacwood and cedarwood wrapped in dry amber and incense.

A fresh-woody built for daytime that keeps its nerve into the evening. Crisp on the spray, smoky and resinous by the second hour.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Lime, Spices
Middle: Neroli, Aromatic Herbs, Violet, Rose
Base: Guaiacwood, Dry Amber, Incense, Cedarwood

item.title: Freeze in Flames by Riiffs – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Freeze in Flames by Riiffs is the fiery counterpart to the brand's own Freeze — an extrait de parfum built on a single contradiction: an ice-cold, fruit-drenched opening sitting on a warm, resinous base. Crushed raspberry, passion fruit and red apple land first, snapped clean by spearmint and bergamot, before aromatic lavender and tea carry it down into cedarwood, musk and Amber Xtreme.

Sweet and frosted up top, warm and magnetic underneath, with a trail that lingers well after the chill burns off. Extrait concentration, so a little goes a long way.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Raspberry, Bergamot, Passion Fruit, Red Apple, Spearmint
Middle: Lavender, Tea
Base: Cedarwood, Musk, Amber Xtreme

item.title: Faris Al Arab by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Warm, resinous, and built for cold weather, Faris Al Arab by Maison Asrar is an oriental woody fragrance with a boozy cherry opening and a deep ambered base. The name translates roughly to "knight of the Arabs," and the composition is built around that idea — rich, confident, and unmistakably Middle Eastern in character.

It opens on cherry liqueur and cashmere wood with a vanilla sweetness underneath, then moves through amber, sugar cane, and cedarwood in the heart. The base is where it settles in for the long haul: sandalwood, tonka bean, labdanum, and musk, warm and balsamic with serious staying power.

Faris Al Arab is an original Maison Asrar composition rather than a take on any designer release, and it's become one of the house's most highly rated fragrances.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cherry Liqueur, Oriental Notes, Cashmere Wood, Vanilla
Middle: Amber, Sugar Cane, Cedarwood
Base: Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Labdanum, Musk

Scent Profile

Faris Al Arab sits in the amber oriental / woody / balsamic lane — sweet and liquorous up top, resinous and woody underneath, with a powdery warmth running through the dry-down.

Expect real presence. This is a cold-weather evening scent that projects and lasts, not a quiet daily wear.

Best For

Season: Fall, winter
Occasion: Evenings out, nights, special occasions, cold-weather wear
Style: Rich, warm, resinous, confident

Try Before You Commit

Faris Al Arab opens with a sweet, almost liqueur-like cherry note over soft woods, which is what gives it that immediate richness. Amber and cedarwood take over within the first hour and pull it warmer and drier, and the sandalwood-tonka-labdanum base holds for most of a day on skin and longer on fabric.

Try Faris Al Arab by Maison Asrar with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Yara by Lattafa – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Sweet, creamy, and instantly recognisable, Yara by Lattafa is the vanilla-gourmand that made the house a household name. It opens soft and powdery — orchid and heliotrope with a squeeze of tangerine — before settling into the tropical-fruit and gourmand heart it's known for.

The base is where it lives: vanilla, musk, and sandalwood, warm and creamy with real staying power. It's a comfort scent first and foremost, the kind people wear daily and buy again.

Yara is an original Lattafa composition rather than a take on any designer release, and it remains one of the most widely loved Middle Eastern fragrances released in the last decade.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Orchid, Heliotrope, Tangerine
Middle: Gourmand Accord, Tropical Fruits
Base: Vanilla, Musk, Sandalwood

Scent Profile

Yara sits in the sweet gourmand / vanilla / powdery oriental lane — soft and floral-powdery on the opening, fruity and sweet through the middle, then creamy vanilla for the long haul.

Expect something warm, sweet and easy to wear. It projects well and lasts, so a light hand goes a long way.

Best For

Season: Fall, winter, cooler weather — though plenty wear it year-round
Occasion: Everyday wear, date nights, casual outings
Style: Sweet, creamy, comforting, feminine

Try Before You Commit

Yara opens powdery and slightly floral, with tangerine keeping the first few minutes bright. The gourmand heart arrives quickly and turns it sweet and fruity, and the vanilla-sandalwood base takes over for the rest of the wear — creamy, warm, and long-lasting.

Try Yara by Lattafa with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Hawwa Pink by Zimaya – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Parfums de Marly Delina
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Fresh, rosy, and effortlessly pretty, Hawwa Pink by Zimaya is a floral fruity fragrance built on rose, litchi, and a clean musky base. It opens with the pairing that defines it — rose and litchi, lifted by pear and bergamot — bright and juicy rather than heavy or old-fashioned.

Turkish rose and peony deepen the heart into something fuller and more floral, while white musk, Haitian vetiver, and soft woods keep the dry-down clean and skin-close instead of powdery.

The rose-litchi structure is why Hawwa Pink gets compared so often to Parfums de Marly Delina. It isn't a copy, but anyone who likes that fresh rosy-fruity signature will recognise the territory immediately.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Rose, Litchi, Pear, Bergamot
Middle: Turkish Rose, Peony
Base: White Musk, Haitian Vetiver, Woody Notes

Scent Profile

Hawwa Pink sits in the rose / fruity floral / clean musk lane — juicy and fresh on top, fully floral through the heart, soft and musky at the base.

Expect something bright and wearable rather than dense. It's a daytime rose, not an evening one.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer
Occasion: Everyday wear, daytime, office, casual outings
Style: Fresh, rosy, fruity, feminine

Try Before You Commit

Hawwa Pink opens on rose and litchi together, which is what gives it that instantly recognisable fresh-rosy character. Peony and Turkish rose build it out through the first hour, and the white musk base keeps the finish soft and clean without turning powdery.

Try Hawwa Pink by Zimaya with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Aussie Glow by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:

Overview

Sun-soaked, creamy, and tropical, Aussie Glow by Bujairami is a fruity gourmand built around mango, coconut, and a smooth vanilla-sandalwood base. It opens juicy and bright — ripe mango cut with grapefruit so the sweetness has an edge rather than going straight to syrup.

The heart is where it turns creamy: coconut and jasmine give it a soft lactonic texture, closer to sunscreen-on-warm-skin than to a dessert. Vanilla, sandalwood, and amber round the dry-down out warm and smooth.

Aussie Glow is an original composition by Adam Bujairami, not a take on any designer release — one of the house's most popular releases and a genuine warm-weather signature.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mango, Grapefruit
Middle: Coconut, Jasmine
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber

Scent Profile

Aussie Glow sits in the tropical fruity / coconut gourmand / creamy woody lane — sweet and juicy up top, lactonic and soft through the middle, warm and woody underneath.

Expect something that reads like a beach day: bright, creamy, and comfortable rather than sharp or loud.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer, hot weather
Occasion: Vacations, beach days, daytime, casual outings
Style: Tropical, creamy, sweet, easygoing

Try Before You Commit

Aussie Glow opens on juicy mango with a grapefruit lift that keeps it from being cloying. Coconut arrives within the first half hour and turns it creamy and smooth, and the base of vanilla and sandalwood keeps it warm on the skin for hours.

Try Aussie Glow by Bujairami with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Drip by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspired by Louis Vuitton Afternoon Swim
Type: Eaux de Parfum
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Overview

Bright, juicy, and unapologetically vibrant, Drip by Bujairami is a citrus extrait built for maximum freshness with concentrated longevity. It opens on the sweet sparkle of mandarin, deepens through ripe orange, and finishes on a refined bergamot bitterness that keeps the whole thing crisp rather than candied.

Minimal in structure and bold in impact — there are only three notes here, and that is the point. Bujairami built it as a tribute to Louis Vuitton's Afternoon Swim, and the extrait concentration gives it noticeably more density and staying power than most citrus fragrances sitting at this price.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mandarin
Middle: Orange
Base: Bergamot

Scent Profile

Drip sits squarely in the citrus / fruity / aldehydic lane — sweet orange sparkle over a clean bitter-citrus finish, with a slight fizzy lift on the opening.

Linear by design: what you smell on the first spray is broadly what you get for hours. That is a feature here, not a shortcut.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer, hot weather
Occasion: Daytime, casual outings, vacations, office
Style: Bright, juicy, clean, energetic

Try Before You Commit

Drip opens with a burst of mandarin that reads sweet and almost fizzy. Orange fills it out through the first hour, and bergamot runs underneath the whole wear, keeping the sweetness in check and giving it a cleaner, more grown-up finish than the opening suggests.

Try Drip by Bujairami with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

Overview

Bright, dry, and quietly refined, Hawas Dreams by Rasasi is a woody fragrance that opens on citrus and lands on powdery iris. Blood orange, grapefruit, and bright citrus make the first impression sharp and juicy without being sour.

The heart is minimal by design — white musk and jasmine, more texture than statement — which lets the base do the work. Vetiver, cedar, and iris close it out dry, earthy, and lightly powdery, the kind of finish that reads clean rather than heavy.

Hawas Dreams is an original Rasasi composition, not a take on any designer release. Launched in 2026, it's one of the newest additions to the Hawas line.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blood Orange, Citrus, Grapefruit
Middle: White Musk, Jasmine
Base: Vetiver, Cedar, Iris

Scent Profile

Hawas Dreams sits in the citrus / woody / powdery musk lane — a bright opening over a dry, grounded base, with iris giving it a soft powdery edge most citrus-woods don't have.

Expect something understated and easy to wear, closer to a clean daily signature than a statement scent.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer
Occasion: Everyday wear, office, daytime, casual outings
Style: Bright, dry, clean, understated

Try Before You Commit

Hawas Dreams opens sharp and juicy on blood orange and grapefruit. The citrus burns off fairly quickly into a soft musk-and-jasmine middle, and the real character arrives in the dry-down — vetiver and cedar with a powdery iris thread running through it, staying close to the skin.

Try Hawas Dreams by Rasasi with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

Warm, sweet, and softly floral, Hawas Love by Rasasi is an oriental floral built around orange blossom, ylang ylang, and a praline-vanilla base. It opens with a gentle spice — pink pepper and cardamom lifted by mandarin — that sets up the florals rather than competing with them.

The heart is the centrepiece: orange blossom, ylang ylang, and jasmine give it a creamy, full white-floral character. Underneath, tonka bean, vanilla, and praline turn the dry-down sweet and comforting, closer to a soft gourmand than a classic oriental.

Hawas Love is an original Rasasi composition, not a take on any designer release. Launched in 2026, it's one of the newest additions to the Hawas line.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pink Pepper, Cardamom, Mandarin
Middle: Orange Blossom, Ylang Ylang, Jasmine
Base: Tonka Bean, Vanilla, Praline

Scent Profile

Hawas Love sits in the sweet oriental / white floral / gourmand lane — spiced and bright for the first few minutes, then creamy florals, then a warm praline finish.

Expect something soft and enveloping rather than sharp — a feminine fragrance with just enough cardamom and pink pepper up top to keep the opening from being purely sweet.

Best For

Season: Fall, winter, cooler evenings
Occasion: Date nights, evenings out, everyday wear in cold weather
Style: Warm, sweet, floral, comforting

Try Before You Commit

Hawas Love opens with a spiced citrus lift that fades quickly into the florals. Within twenty minutes orange blossom and ylang ylang take over and turn creamy, and as it settles the tonka and praline base brings a warm, sweet finish that sits close to the skin.

Try Hawas Love by Rasasi with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

Overview

Tropical, sweet, and sun-soaked, Marbella by Mykonos is a fruity-gourmand built on exotic fruit over a warm, resinous base. It opens vivid — passionfruit and mango alongside orange and lemon — for a first impression that's unmistakably holiday.

Frangipani and solar notes carry the tropical feeling into the heart, with blackcurrant adding a tart edge. Then it deepens: vanilla, benzoin, labdanum, and musk give the dry-down a balsamic amber richness that most summer fruit scents never reach.

Marbella is an original Mykonos composition from the Sunforged collection — the brand frames it around endless sunsets and warm ocean air rather than any existing fragrance.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Orange, Lemon, Passionfruit, Mango
Middle: Frangipani, Solar Notes, Blackcurrant
Base: Vanilla, Benzoin, Musk, Labdanum

Scent Profile

Marbella sits in the tropical fruity / sweet / amber balsamic lane — bright and juicy on top, warm and resinous underneath.

Expect a fragrance that reads as a summer scent but wears with enough vanilla and amber depth to work well past sundown.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer, warm weather year-round
Occasion: Vacations, beach days, evenings out, casual outings
Style: Tropical, sweet, warm, seductive

Try Before You Commit

Marbella opens on a burst of passionfruit and mango cut with orange and lemon — colourful and immediately warm-weather. Frangipani bridges it into a creamy floral middle, and as it dries down labdanum and benzoin bring out a soft, balsamic amber that keeps the fruit from feeling thin.

item.title: Inferno by Mykonos – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Spiced, earthy, and deceptively bright, Inferno by Mykonos is a woody-spicy fragrance that opens fresh and turns dark. Blackcurrant, bergamot, and grapefruit lead, sharpened by a caramelized pineapple accord that gives the opening a sticky, sun-warmed edge.

The heart is where the heat lives: clove, nutmeg, ginger, and cardamom stack into a dense spice blend, with rose softening the middle. Patchouli, oakmoss, vetiver, amber, tonka, and ambroxan then pull the dry-down somewhere earthier and more classically structured.

Despite the name, Inferno isn't built on smoke or burning woods — the heat comes entirely from the spices. Part of the Mykonos Sunforged collection.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blackcurrant, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Caramelized Pineapple
Middle: Clove, Nutmeg, Ginger, Cardamom, Rose
Base: Patchouli, Oakmoss, Amber, Musk, Vetiver, Tonka, Ambroxan

Scent Profile

Inferno sits in the warm spicy / woody / earthy mossy lane — the driest and darkest of the Sunforged four, with just enough citrus and tonka to keep it from going austere.

Expect a fragrance that opens bright and closes serious, with real projection and a trail that lingers.

Best For

Season: Fall, winter
Occasion: Evenings out, nights, cooler-weather everyday wear
Style: Spicy, earthy, bold, structured

Try Before You Commit

Inferno opens with grapefruit and blackcurrant over that caramelized pineapple note, bright and a little sweet. Within half an hour the spice heart takes over — clove and nutmeg first, then ginger and cardamom — and the dry-down settles into patchouli, oakmoss, and vetiver for an earthy, long-lasting finish.

Try Inferno by Mykonos with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

Overview

Bright, juicy, and easy to wear, Nautilus by Mykonos is a fruity-floral built around pear, citrus, and soft woods. It opens with a sparkling burst of pear, bergamot, mandarin orange, and a slice of fresh ginger — luminous rather than sharp.

The heart carries the pear forward and wraps it in orange blossom and jasmine for a clean white-floral centre. Amber, musk, vanilla, guaiac wood, and ambroxan then form a warm, smooth base that keeps it grounded without turning heavy.

Nautilus is an original Mykonos composition from the Sunforged collection — the brand describes it as oceanic summer freshness, fresh on the surface and powerful underneath.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pear, Bergamot, Ginger, Mandarin Orange
Middle: Pear, Orange Blossom, Jasmine
Base: Amber, Musk, Vanilla, Guaiac Wood, Ambroxan

Scent Profile

Nautilus sits in the fruity / white floral / musky lane — juicy and sparkling up top, clean and floral through the heart, soft and warm in the dry-down.

Expect the most luminous and approachable of the Sunforged four: pear sweetness, floral lift, and a smooth vanilla-musk landing.

Best For

Season: Spring, summer
Occasion: Everyday wear, daytime, vacations, casual outings
Style: Bright, juicy, clean, effortless

Nautilus opens juicy and sparkling, with pear and mandarin leading and ginger adding a little bite. As it settles, orange blossom and jasmine bring a clean floral centre, and the base of amber, musk, and guaiac wood gives it a smooth, warm finish that stays close to the skin.

Try Nautilus by Mykonos with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.

item.title: Untamed by Mykonos – Sample Decant
item.description:

Type:

Overview

Clean, creamy, and quietly luxurious, Untamed by Mykonos is a woody gourmand built around a crisp linen accord, coconut, praline, and smooth cashmeran woods. It opens bright and airy — blackcurrant, bergamot, and lemon over a laundered-linen freshness that sets it apart from the usual sweet woody opening.

The heart is where it turns creamy: coconut and praline bring a soft, dessert-like sweetness, while violet and musk add a powdery lift. The base of cashmeran, cedarwood, vetiver, amber, and vanilla gives the whole thing structure, so the sweetness never runs away with it.

Untamed sits in the same territory as Byredo's Bal d'Afrique Absolu and Alto Astral — that polished, musky-clean signature with warmth underneath. Part of the Mykonos Sunforged collection.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Linen, Blackcurrant, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Coconut, Praline, Jasmine, Violet, Musk
Base: Cashmeran, Cedarwood, Vetiver, Amber, Vanilla

Scent Profile

Untamed sits in the musky / woody gourmand / powdery lane — clean on the surface, creamy in the middle, softly woody at the base.

Expect a fragrance that feels fresh-laundered and expensive at the same time, with enough coconut-praline sweetness to read as comforting rather than sharp.

Best For

Season: Year-round, best in spring and summer
Occasion: Everyday wear, office, date nights, casual outings
Style: Clean, creamy, polished, understated

Try Before You Commit

Untamed opens with a crisp citrus-and-linen freshness that feels almost soapy in the best way. Within twenty minutes coconut and praline soften it into something creamy and rounded, and the dry-down settles into cashmeran and cedarwood for a warm, skin-close finish.

Try Untamed by Mykonos with a Decantified 1ml sample and experience the full evolution before committing to a full bottle.
